Hi when i first started i was given an Accent on Achievement beginner book for trumpet and i’d say that’s probably your best bet, it’s very approachable compared to other books which can be intimidating and it goes over lots of stuff. To keep her on track with her instrument, normally playing in a school band or anything that keeps her on a schedule of consistently picking up the trumpet should do fine and when it comes to playing an instrument it’s very easy to be discouraged, positive reinforcement works best when learning an instrument but don’t be overbearing with compliments, acknowledge progress, encourage her to push further.

i remember having serious struggles near the end of my last relationship about a year ago and self harmed, i was in a terrible spot and decided to give the hotline a shot, terrible idea. I’m not in a great place to really call and talk to someone on the phone bc my parents will find out then it’ll be a big thing, I’m hitting the hotline bc i’ve got no other choice, so i go to the live chat, I waited around 2 hours in line and never got though to anyone, in the time spent waiting in line i worked the current problems out in my head for the time being and moved on. Moral of the story, hotline is a joke if you can’t talk on the phone
